The '''Vipers''' were a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that were led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kessra]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Vipers joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the end of the conflict they were stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. To avoid arrest by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Vipers went into hiding and reformed theemselves into a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], and they seized control of the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]]. Unknown to the rest of the gang, Kessra also began working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] and she used the gang as a means by which to achieve Darga's goals in Zarra. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Zarra and the Vipers subsequently surrounded the agents [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class star yacht]] [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']], and claimed that the agents had not paid the Vipers a landing fee and thus each owed the gang 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="A Wretched Hive (Dawn of Defiance)" />
